scientific_requirements: Score only task-scoped paper scientific findings, never research process, tool counts, cost, formatting or failure explanations. Every item is binary: full assigned points for a supported match, otherwise zero for an incorrect or absent result. Identify molecules, connectivity, atom inventory, charge/spin, observable, units, reference state and conditions before comparing. Require genuine linked computations and native artifacts; supplied observations, copied paper values and normal termination alone are insufficient. Validate minima and transition states as required by the unchanged public task. Alternative software, methods and candidate labels are permitted when the physical result is comparable. No historical verification trajectory, fixed hypothesis count or computation outside the public scope is required. Numeric targets and tolerances are fixed, absolute and inclusive; the host computes agreement and the Judge must not adjust them. A contextual source number without an authored numeric rule creates no numerical gate. Qualitative items are independent of numeric-window passes and need their own actual computational support. An unsupported or failed item loses only its own points. Final conclusions require explicit supported inference or selection. Genuine unresolved essential physical identity/reference ambiguity requires needs_review; publication review pending alone does not block this version.
